name: space-lunik-kidnapping.pdf
description: The Winter 1967 *Studies in Intelligence* front matter (Vol. 11, No. 1, declassified 2019) sets out the journal's editorial policy and Editorial Board, and "The Kidnaping of the Lunik" describes a covert CIA operation that borrowed a Soviet Lunik probe stage from a foreign trade exhibition, photographed and sampled it at a salvage yard, and reassembled it to recover factory markings and production details.
